thread:
Nina Gomez: FYI: Renewal for MapleCare in two weeks. Need an SLA one-pager showing 30d uptime, p95 latency, incident highlights, and a plain-language credits example for the renewal packet. Who can assemble?

Ethan White: I can get the metrics. Which service and regions?

Nina Gomez: Service = mc-prod-embed. Regions: us-east-1 primary, eu-central-1 backup. Also note they use Dedicated for peak windows.

Priya Rao: I'll draft the customer-facing paragraph and an FAQ item: "How are credits calculated?". Want formal T&C text included?

Nina Gomez: Yes include the T&C blurb. Tom, can you confirm any recent incidents that would affect uptime numbers?

Tom Blake: There was a 12-minute degraded event on 2027-05-14 due to a routing config rollback; root-cause doc is in /incidents/2027-05-14-mc-routing. No other customer-impacting incidents in 30d.

Ethan White: Pulling metrics now. Command I'll run: ```
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/summary?service=mc-prod-embed&period=30d&group=region" | jq .
```
I'll drop CSV + screenshots to /shared/reports/maplecare/1811112222.

Priya Rao: Draft will cover: what triggers credits, example calc, and next steps for remediation. I'll keep it customer-friendly.

Ethan White: Uploaded metrics.csv and grafana.png. Quick summary: us-east-1 uptime=99.962%, eu-central-1 uptime=99.999%, p95_us-east-1=120ms.

Nina Gomez: Thanks. Priya, for the worked example use $20k monthly commit and our SLA tiers: >=99.95% no credit; 99.9-99.95 => 3% credit; 99.0-99.9 => 8% credit. For us-east-1 observed 99.962% => no credit regionally, but show combined example too.

Tom Blake: I'll attach the incident summary and mitigation steps to the folder.

Priya Rao: Draft uploaded to the folder. I added an FAQ line: "Credits are applied to the billing cycle following validation and require customer acceptance of the adjustments."

Nina Gomez: Nice. Internal review needed today so renewals can include in customer packet tomorrow. Please flag any blockers here by 3pm PT.

Ethan White: Metrics + snapshots done. No blockers from my side.

Tom Blake: Incident doc uploaded.

Priya Rao: Legal-approved T&C text linked in doc. Ready for review.

Nina Gomez: Great work team — I'll consolidate and send to renewals for customer delivery. :rocket:
